verses.en: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
verses.pt: Tendo Jesus dito isto, saiu com seus discípulos para o outro lado do ribeiro de Cedrom, onde havia um jardim, e com eles ali entrou.

verses.en: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
verses.pt: Ora, Judas, que o traía, também conhecia aquele lugar, porque muitas vezes Jesus se reunira ali com os discípulos.

verses.en: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
verses.pt: Tendo, pois, Judas tomado a coorte e uns guardas da parte dos principais sacerdotes e fariseus, chegou ali com lanternas archotes e armas.

verses.en: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?
verses.pt: Sabendo, pois, Jesus tudo o que lhe havia de suceder, adiantou-se e perguntou-lhes: A quem buscais?

verses.en: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I amhe. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
verses.pt: Responderam-lhe: A Jesus, o nazareno. Disse-lhes Jesus: Sou eu. E Judas, que o traía, também estava com eles.

verses.en: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
verses.pt: Quando Jesus lhes disse: Sou eu, recuaram, e cairam por terra.

verses.en: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.pt: Tornou-lhes então a perguntar: A quem buscais? e responderam: A Jesus, o nazareno.

verses.en: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
verses.pt: Replicou-lhes Jesus: Já vos disse que sou eu; se, pois, é a mim que buscais, deixai ir estes;

verses.en: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.
verses.pt: para que se cumprisse a palavra que dissera: Dos que me tens dado, nenhum deles perdi.

verses.en: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
verses.pt: Então Simão Pedro, que tinha uma espada, desembainhou-a e feriu o servo do sumo sacerdote, cortando-lhe a orelha direita. O nome do servo era Malco.

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
verses.pt: Disse, pois, Jesus a Pedro: Mete a tua espada na bainha; não hei de beber o cálice que o Pai me deu?

verses.en: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
verses.pt: Então a coorte, e o comandante, e os guardas dos judeus prenderam a Jesus, e o maniataram.

verses.en: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
verses.pt: E conduziram-no primeiramente a Anás; pois era sogro de Caifás, sumo sacerdote naquele ano.

verses.en: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
verses.pt: Ora, Caifás era quem aconselhara aos judeus que convinha morrer um homem pelo povo.

verses.en: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
verses.pt: Simão Pedro e outro discípulo seguiam a Jesus. Este discípulo era conhecido do sumo sacerdote, e entrou com Jesus no pátio do sumo sacerdote,

verses.en: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
verses.pt: enquanto Pedro ficava da parte de fora, à porta. Saiu, então, o outro discípulo que era conhecido do sumo sacerdote, falou à porteira, e levou Pedro para dentro.

verses.en: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man’s disciples? He saith, I am not.
verses.pt: Então a porteira perguntou a Pedro: Não és tu também um dos discípulos deste homem? Respondeu ele: Não sou.

verses.en: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
verses.pt: Ora, estavam ali os servos e os guardas, que tinham acendido um braseiro e se aquentavam, porque fazia frio; e também Pedro estava ali em pé no meio deles, aquentando-se.

verses.en: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
verses.pt: Então o sumo sacerdote interrogou Jesus acerca dos seus discípulos e da sua doutrina.

verses.en: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Eu tenho falado abertamente ao mundo; eu sempre ensinei nas sinagogas e no templo, onde todos os judeus se congregam, e nada falei em oculto.

verses.en: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
verses.pt: Por que me perguntas a mim? pergunta aos que me ouviram o que é que lhes falei; eis que eles sabem o que eu disse.

verses.en: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?
verses.pt: E, havendo ele dito isso, um dos guardas que ali estavam deu uma bofetada em Jesus, dizendo: É assim que respondes ao sumo sacerdote?

verses.en: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Se falei mal, dá testemunho do mal; mas, se bem, por que me feres?

verses.en: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
verses.pt: Então Anás o enviou, maniatado, a Caifás, o sumo sacerdote.

verses.en: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.
verses.pt: E Simão Pedro ainda estava ali, aquentando-se. Perguntaram- lhe, pois: Não és também tu um dos seus discípulos? Ele negou, e disse: Não sou.

verses.en: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
verses.pt: Um dos servos do sumo sacerdote, parente daquele a quem Pedro cortara a orelha, disse: Não te vi eu no jardim com ele?

verses.en: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.
verses.pt: Pedro negou outra vez, e imediatamente o galo cantou.

verses.en: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
verses.pt: Depois conduziram Jesus da presença de Caifás para o pretório; era de manhã cedo; e eles não entraram no pretório, para não se contaminarem, mas poderem comer a páscoa.

verses.en: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?
verses.pt: Então Pilatos saiu a ter com eles, e perguntou: Que acusação trazeis contra este homem?

verses.en: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.
verses.pt: Responderam-lhe: Se ele não fosse malfeitor, não to entregaríamos.

verses.en: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
verses.pt: Disse-lhes, então, Pilatos: Tomai-o vós, e julgai-o segundo a vossa lei. Disseram-lhe os judeus: A nós não nos é lícito tirar a vida a ninguém.

verses.en: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.
verses.pt: Isso foi para que se cumprisse a palavra que dissera Jesus, significando de que morte havia de morrer.

verses.en: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?
verses.pt: Pilatos, pois, tornou a entrar no pretório, chamou a Jesus e perguntou-lhe: És tu o rei dos judeus?

verses.en: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?
verses.pt: Respondeu Jesus: Dizes isso de ti mesmo, ou foram outros que to disseram de mim?

verses.en: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
verses.pt: Replicou Pilatos: Porventura sou eu judeu? O teu povo e os principais sacerdotes entregaram-te a mim; que fizeste?

verses.en: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
verses.pt: Respondeu Jesus: O meu reino não é deste mundo; se o meu reino fosse deste mundo, pelejariam os meus servos, para que eu não fosse entregue aos judeus; entretanto o meu reino não é daqui.

verses.en: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
verses.pt: Perguntou-lhe, pois, Pilatos: Logo tu és rei? Respondeu Jesus: Tu dizes que eu sou rei. Eu para isso nasci, e para isso vim ao mundo, a fim de dar testemunho da verdade. Todo aquele que é da verdade ouve a minha voz.

verses.en: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
verses.pt: Perguntou-lhe Pilatos: Que é a verdade? E dito isto, de novo saiu a ter com os judeus, e disse-lhes: Não acho nele crime algum.

verses.en: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
verses.pt: Tendes, porém, por costume que eu vos solte alguém por ocasião da páscoa; quereis, pois, que vos solte o rei dos judeus?

verses.en: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
verses.pt: Então todos tornaram a clamar dizendo: Este não, mas Barrabás. Ora, Barrabás era salteador.
